name: What is an operable skylight?
description: An operable skylight is a roof-mounted window that can open for ventilation and light, unlike a fixed skylight.

acceptedAnswer.text: An operable skylight is a window installed on a roof that can be opened or closed, either manually or via a remote control system. This feature allows for natural ventilation, helping to regulate indoor temperatures and improve air quality. It differs from a fixed skylight, which provides natural light but does not open. When considering an operable skylight, assess your ventilation needs and roof access to determine if a manual crank or an electric/solar-powered option is more suitable for your home.
